title: SAP Mobile Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Work as part of SAP Empowered Product Teams, design, develop, and maintain frontend application features for cross platform mobile SAP Service and Asset Manager.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of standard and SAP mobile technology in development and testing, such as SAP BTP Mobile Services, SAP Mobile Development Kit, JavaScript, TypeScript, Visual Studio Code, Xcode, Android Studio, ilodata, SQL, Ultralite DB, Appium, Java, SAP Business Application Studio, Github, CI/CD with Hyperspace Fastlane, OData Services, SAP Gateway, S/4HANA system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, feature requirement

Actively collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines for each platform, iOS, Android and Windows, and figma design for the application.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with backend integration service developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration in frontend logic

Use S/4HANA system and its relevant business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), and data objects (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), setup necessary test data in S/4HANA system, perform end-to-end test, and validate developed features against S/4HANA system.

Conduct thorough testing, including unit testing, integration test, and UI automation test scripts for developed features

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, crashes, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead MDK developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

Health insurance

Life insurance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Work as part of SAP Empowered Product Teams, design, develop, and maintain frontend application features for cross platform mobile SAP Service and Asset Manager.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of standard and SAP mobile technology in development and testing, such as SAP BTP Mobile Services, SAP Mobile Development Kit, JavaScript, TypeScript, Visual Studio Code, Xcode, Android Studio, ilodata, SQL, Ultralite DB, Appium, Java, SAP Business Application Studio, Github, CI/CD with Hyperspace Fastlane, OData Services, SAP Gateway, S/4HANA system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, feature requirement

Actively collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines for each platform, iOS, Android and Windows, and figma design for the application.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with backend integration service developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration in frontend logic

Use S/4HANA system and its relevant business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), and data objects (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), setup necessary test data in S/4HANA system, perform end-to-end test, and validate developed features against S/4HANA system.

Conduct thorough testing, including unit testing, integration test, and UI automation test scripts for developed features

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, crashes, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead MDK developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Engenheiro de Dados SR

CLT, remoto e necessário inglês avançado.


Experiência recomendada: 5 a 7 anos de experiência prática em desenvolvimento de aplicativos de BI


• Capacidade de identificar riscos técnicos e de segurança e propor ações de mitigação

• Experiência prática em Práticas de Gerenciamento de Configuração e Liberação

• Participar de modificações de software durante testes de integração

• Entender os requisitos das partes interessadas e documentá-los sob orientação

• Propor mudanças para melhorar a eficiência e/ou reduzir os custos de operação ou manutenção;

• Criar boas práticas e propor melhorias

• Reunir requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, incluindo requisitos de segurança da informação, das partes interessadas e documentá-los



Habilidades Obrigatórias

• Azure Cloud: Proficiência em serviços de dados (Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Functions, Key Vault, etc.)

• Databricks: Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento de pipelines, transformação de dados, notebooks (Python/Scala) e otimização do Spark

• CI/CD: Compreensão dos fluxos de trabalho de DevOps para implantação de pipelines (Azure DevOps, Git)

• Modelagem de Dados: Bom conhecimento dos conceitos de Data Lakehouse, Delta Lake, gerenciamento de esquemas e ajuste de desempenho

• DataOps: Experiência em gerenciamento de qualidade de dados, monitoramento de tarefas, registro e alertas

• Sólido conhecimento de arquiteturas distribuídas, desempenho do Spark e formatos de dados (Parquet, Avro, JSON)

• Forte proficiência em Python e SQL

title: Analista de FinOps Sênior
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais, somos GPTW.


Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys! Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


Como Analista de FinOps Sênior, você terá um papel estratégico e consultivo, atuando como um Advisor técnico. Suas principais atividades incluem:

Otimização de custos:

• Identificar e implementar oportunidades de otimização de custos e uso de recursos do Google Cloud, com foco em serviços de

• Data & Analytics.

Análise e insights:

• Analisar grandes volumes de dados de uso para gerar insights acionáveis, demonstrando o valor e o retorno financeiro das ações de otimização.

Governança e processos:

• Criar, documentar e implementar processos de FinOps, estabelecendo uma governança sólida para o uso de recursos na nuvem.

Comunicação e colaboração:

• Apresentar resultados, relatórios e recomendações para líderes de tecnologia, produtos e diretores, traduzindo complexidade técnica em informações claras e estratégicas.

Autonomia e proatividade:

• Gerenciar suas próprias demandas, atuando com alta autonomia e auto-gestão para impulsionar a agenda de FinOps da empresa.


Diferencial:

Experiência no ciclo de vida de APIs (concepção, design, implantação, testes e manutenção)


Habilidades:


Habilidades Técnicas:


- BigQuery

- BigTable

- Dataproc

- Cloud Storage

- DataFlow

- Cloud Composer

- GOOGLE CLOUD PLATFORM


Habilidades Comportamentais:


- Autonomia

- Comunicação


Idiomas:


- Inglês


Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Remoto


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!


Assistência médica;

VR e VA flexível;

Gympass e Wellz;

Parceria com o SESC;

Descontos em restaurantes;

Descontos em cursos técnicos e de ensinos superior;

Descontos em escolas e plataformas de idiomas.


E aí, aceita o desafio? Então conclua sua candidatura e #VemSerFoursys! Boa sorte!

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
About the Role and Reponsabilities:

In this role you will have the chance to build large additions to our platform ecosystem, contributing to an infrastructure that centralizes our ETL and streaming infrastructure, enables experimentation and data development, and powers algorithm development. You will design and build scalable engineering solutions to solve business and data problems.


Core tech stack used by this role:

-S3 using Parquet and Iceberg for data storage

-Hive and Iceberg REST catalog as our metadata store

-Spark (Python, SQL, Scala) for data transformation

-Go, Scala and Java for backend development

-Kafka for data streaming

-Kubernetes and Helm for service deployments

-AWS IAM for access control

-Datadog for logging alerting and monitoring

-Trino as our federated query engine

-Identify, develop, and evangelize tooling, approaches, and data products that raise the bar of validity in experiment design and analyses across the company

-Collaborate with multiple teams and functions to deliver deep-dive analyses and experiment design for new initiatives and high-priority business areas

-Develop and iterate on our processes to empower more efficient and rigorous experimentation


Requirements

-You have a degree in an engineering or computer science field

-You have solid experience in platform engineering, with experience on experimentation platforms

-You have experience coding at a production level in Python, Go, Scala or Java

-You’ve built and supported RBAC systems used by enterprise-wide teams

-You have experience supporting Iceberg-based data warehouses



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Especialista em Engenharia de Vendas
description:
Estamos buscamos alguém apaixonado por tecnologia e negócios para atuar como elo estratégico entre nossos clientes e nossa plataforma de automação financeira .


Se você tem perfil consultivo, gosta de transformar desafios em soluções e quer gerar impacto real em grandes empresas, essa vaga é para você! terá a missão de apoiar as áreas Comercial e de Sucesso do Cliente no desenvolvimento de oportunidades técnicas, funcionando como ponte estratégica entre o produto e os clientes. Atuará de forma consultiva em todas as etapas do ciclo de vendas, interpretando demandas de negócio e transformando-as em soluções técnicas. Sua atuação garantirá que a nossa plataforma gere valor concreto para instituições financeiras, fintechs e grandes empresas, especialmente em projetos de automação de conciliações financeiras e de integração com sistemas corporativos — como ERPs, processadores de pagamento e outras plataformas essenciais ao negócio.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Ser o braço direito dos executivos de contas em reuniões de pré-venda, conduzindo demonstrações técnicas, POCs e apresentações sobre arquitetura e segurança ;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para clientes em temas de pagamentos, conciliação financeira, automação de processos e integração de sistemas;
  • Mapear requisitos, identificar riscos e propor alternativas técnicas antes do fechamento de cada contrato;
  • Criar propostas e documentações técnicas, garantindo clareza no escopo e alinhamento com os times de projeto;
  • Participar de kickoffs técnicos , assegurando que expectativa e entrega caminhem lado a lado;
  • Colaborar com Produto e Implantação, trazendo insights estratégicos a partir de tendências em meios de pagamento e integração financeira.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Comunicação clara e objetiva em português e inglês ou espanhol;
  • Experiência em pré-vendas, vendas consultivas ou engenharia de soluções em softwares B2B;
  • Conhecimento sólido em pagamentos, core banking, orquestração ou automação financeira;
  • Capacidade de traduzir questões técnicas em propostas de valor para executivos de negócio;
  • Facilidade em conduzir apresentações técnicas, workshops e demos para grandes clientes;
  • Perfil consultivo, com habilidade de construir confiança e influência junto a líderes de tecnologia e finanças.


Diferenciais que vão brilhar no processo:

✨ Experiência com integração de APIs ou automação de data analytics;

✨ Passagem por fintechs, adquirentes, processadoras ou consultorias de tecnologia financeira.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $800 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,600 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Sap Materials Management Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP MM/DRC- S/4HANA,Remote mode who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Must Have

Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, NFe knowledge and enhancements to supply processes specially with SAP DRC, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects. Experience with SAP DRC inbound.


Good to Have

Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC outbound.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requitements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for resolving any SAP issues reported by the business users and delivering all enhancements and upgrade issues as required by business users.

Lead the end-to-end implementation of SAP DRC NF-e projects, including requirement gathering, configuration, testing, and deployment.

Customize and optimize SAP DRC solutions to ensure seamless electronic invoicing (NF-e) compliance in Brazil or other supported jurisdictions.

Ensure accurate integration of SAP DRC with external systems, including government tax portals and legacy systems.

Provide subject matter expertise on local tax regulations and compliance requirements for e-invoicing.

Identify risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies during the project lifecycle.

Conduct user training, support issue resolution, and provide go-live assistance.

Maintain documentation for processes, configurations, and project changes.

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Experience in a Professional Consumers and package (CPG) company is an asset.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Oficial Quarto de Náutica
description:
Oficial Quarto de Náutica / 2nd Officer


Sobre a CBO:

Somos a segunda maior empresa, em número de embarcações, do Brasil, no segmento offshore, com mais de 40 anos de tradição, inovação e pioneirismo.

Nossos principais valores são segurança, sustentabilidade, integridade, atendimento, resultado, inovação e gente. Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão, e buscamos criar um ambiente cada vez mais diverso e seguro para todas e todos. Temos como estratégia a contratação de pessoas com deficiência e outros públicos diversos, como mulheres, negros, e o público LGBTQIA+.


Sobre a oportunidade:

Estamos em busca de Oficiais de Náutica (OQN) para atuar a bordo das embarcações da CBO, garantindo a condução segura, eficiente e em conformidade com os padrões internacionais de navegação e segurança marítima.


O profissional será responsável por apoiar as operações de navegação, manobra, posicionamento dinâmico e segurança da embarcação, contribuindo diretamente para a excelência operacional e para os resultados da companhia.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como Oficial de Quarto de Navegação/2nd Officer , monitorando rota, derrota e sistemas de navegação;


  • Apoiar o Comandante nas manobras e operações de posicionamento dinâmico (DP );


  • Planejar e executar a navegação conforme normas nacionais e internacionais (IMO, ISM, ISPS, RIPEAM,STCW );


  • Supervisionar atividades de convés e garantir a aplicação das políticas de Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Qualidade (SMS / QSMS);


  • Executar as rotinas de segurança e salvatagem garantindo a aplicação das políticas de Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Qualidade (SMS / QSMS);


  • Participar ativamente da rotina de bordo, mantendo disciplina operacional e foco em segurança;


  • Zelar pela manutenção e correta utilização dos equipamentos de navegação.



Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Formação em Ciências Náuticas (EFOMM, CIAGA ou CIABA, ASON ou ACON) ;
  • CIR ativa e certificados STCW válidos ;
  • Conhecimento em ISM, ISPS e normas da Autoridade Marítima Brasileira ;
  • Certificação DP Basic;

title: Consultor de Investimentos WS - Parceiros XP | Rio Grande do Sul
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

title: AI Staff Engineer (Remote)
description:
AI Staff EngineerWe are a collective group of fearless people with a clear purpose: to empower professionals around the world through intelligent workflow automation software. Currently, more than 500 people across 7 countries work with us, remotely or in a hybrid way, to make life easier for over 3,000 companies using Pipefy in more than 180 countries. Since our founding in 2015, we have put people at the center of everything we do, so we invite you to learn more about this position and apply to be part of our team.


You’ll be responsible for empowering users to make the productivity revolution happen in their companies.


As an AI Developer at Pipefy, your mission is to leverage AI to solve user problems proactively! It can be programming a new feature, polishing existing features, supporting a team member, giving feedback, or solving a bug. Your role is crucial in driving our AI capabilities forward.


You'll have the opportunity to conduct and participate in experiments, make suggestions to improve our architecture and product and use tons of data to make the best decisions.


Since we are fully remote, you'll meet and work with people from all around the world.


One paragraph resume about what people can expect from working in this position (Mission in the role, responsibilities, seniority and what profile we are looking for).


Main Responsibilities:


- Develop new features from start to finish: through conception, research, implementation, and maintenance, as well as improve existing ones, focusing on AI-driven functionalities.

- Take responsibility for the system quality by driving testability together with architects and QAs to ensure that the way we design our platform enables controllability and automation.

- Take responsibility for system stability, ensuring proper testing and observability, actively monitoring production behavior, and reacting quickly to incidents.

- Share knowledge with the team and learn together. We believe knowledge is much more valuable when shared, so we’re always learning and teaching each other.

- Take part in the continuous improvement of Engineering processes, like recruiting, hiring, onboarding, documentation, incidents, tech talks, etc.

- Sought out for technical guidance on your squad and related ones, anticipate technical issues at the product level, and make architectural and design decisions to avoid them.

- Consistently reduce the complexity of projects, systems, and processes to get more done with less work. Breaks up deliverables to optimize for earlier feedback and incremental delivery of business value.

- Help the team develop a more robust engineering culture focused on quality and impactful deliveries by setting an example and mentorship.

- Identify and proactively create projects to fix Pipefy's architecture when preconditions change and current architecture is not optimal/fit anymore, extracting and documenting platforms whenever necessary.


Requirements:


- Write correct, clean code with periodic guidance; consistently follows best practices, including tests (unit, functional, integration).

- Exceptional proficiency in Python, LLM applications and AI model integration.

- Design and develop code to provide an integrated and managed development life cycle for traditional and generative ML applications.

- Experience using LLM-based frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph and others.

- Experience in implementing RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems and working with vector databases.

- Have practical knowledge about infrastructure, service architectures, tools, libraries, frameworks, continuous integration, and continuous deployment systems.

- Able to seamlessly learn and guide others across large sections of our codebase.

- Actively contributes to the technical design of features.

- Understand and make well-reasoned design tradeoffs in their area.

- Strong ability with RESTful.


Bonus point:


- Experience in fine-tuning pre-trained LLMs.

- Infrastructure: Cloud Computing, AWS, Networks, Load Balancers, Web Servers, Containerization, Docker, Kubernetes, Disaster Recovery, Monitoring.

- Experience with document processing and data extraction pipelines.

- Experience with GraphQL apis.

- You have a sharp eye for UX/UI, and you work user-centered.

- Experience with different types of methodologies and tools for Unit, Integration and End to End testing.

- Have good communication in oral and written English.

- Experience working on agile and lean methodologies.

- Experience building and scaling complex, high-performance, high-transaction applications.


Benefits:


- Health and Dental Plan

- Individual Life Insurance

- Flexible Hours (in compliance with daily work hours)

- Flexible Meal/Food Allowance

- Home Office Support

- Furniture Assistance

- Psychological Support (for you or legal dependents)

- Wellhub

- Extended Maternity and Paternity Leave

- School/Nanny Allowance

- Supplemental Nutrition Assistance

- Veterinary Plan

- Birthday Day Off

- Marriage Leave (7 days)

- Bereavement Leave for Loved Ones (10 days)

- Bereavement Leave for Adoption or Pet Loss (2 days)

- Individual Funeral Assistance

- Monthly Education Support

- Payroll Loan

- Financial Consulting

- Udemy Corporate Access

- Coworking Space

- Pipefy License for up to 10 Users

You'll have the opportunity to conduct and participate in experiments, make suggestions to improve our architecture and product and use tons of data to make the best decisions.

title: Contact Center Executive - Customer Service
description:
About Us:


HBX Group is the world’s leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality. We’re headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide.


We are seeking a Global Contact Center Executive to join our dynamic Contact Center team. In this role, you will support our clients and suppliers, contributing to one of our core missions: delivering unique holiday experiences to our customers . This opportunity is open to candidates currently residing in Jundiaí .


Role Overview

The primary responsibility of this role is to assist clients—including tour operators, travel agencies, and end customers—with their inquiries, liaise with suppliers, and manage bookings in alignment with the standards and procedures of the Operations Department. The goal is to address client needs efficiently and effectively.


Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with callers in a professional and enthusiastic manner, representing HBX Group with excellence.
  • Provide accurate and helpful information in response to client inquiries.
  • Document all call activity clearly and accurately in the Back Office system.
  • Respond promptly and precisely to online and email requests.
  • Monitor and manage bookings, including reservations, special requests, amendments, and cancellations.
  • Escalate issues appropriately, following Contact Center protocols.
  • Maintain high standards of service quality and professionalism.
  • Meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures.
  • Follow assigned schedules and adapt to changes based on call volume.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong customer service orientation and active listening skills.
  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, with attention to grammar and clarity.
  • Problem-solving mindset with persistence in resolving issues accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions independently.
  • High attention to detail and adaptability.
  • Consistent focus and enthusiasm throughout the work shift.


If you are passionate about customer service, communication, and creative problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today!


Note: Only candidates currently living in Jundiaí will be considered for this position in the Hybrid Model.



At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Sales Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates: $1,000 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates: $2,000 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $12,5 - $16 depending on level of experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule: The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary: The Sales Assistant will be responsible for generating leads, nurturing prospects, and closing sales for the U.S.-based companies. The ideal candidate will be results-driven, relationship-focused, and experienced in B2B/B2C sales processes. This role involves prospecting, lead qualification, product demonstrations, and maintaining client relationships to drive revenue growth in a remote environment.


Job Tasks:


  • Lead Generation: Research and identify potential customers through various channels and databases.
  • Prospecting: Conduct outbound calls, emails, and social media outreach to qualify leads.
  • Sales Presentations: Deliver product or services demos and presentations to prospects via video calls and phone.
  • CRM Management: Track leads, opportunities, and customer interactions in CRM systems.
  • Pipeline Management: Monitor sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and report on sales metrics.
  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing customers.
  • Market Research: Analyze market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with marketing and customer success teams to optimize sales processes.


Qualifications:


  • 1+ years of related sales experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong negotiation and closing abilities.
  • Experience with B2B or B2C sales processes.
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • A quiet, private workspace with reliable internet connection.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.)
  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • Video conferencing tools (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet)
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • WhatsApp Business
  • Sales engagement platforms (Outreach, SalesLoft, etc.)
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory (C1level)
  • Spanish mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Analista de Implantação Pleno - Protheus RH
description:
Sobre a empresa


Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


Aqui temos um ambiente dinâmico, que celebra a diversidade, promove a inclusão e está sempre em busca dos melhores resultados! Acreditamos no poder transformador da tecnologia e na sua capacidade de contribuir para a construção de uma sociedade mais diversa e inclusiva. Por isso, temos compromisso com nossa política e programa de diversidade e inclusão para garantirmos um ecossistema cada vez mais representativo, respeitoso e acolhedor.


#ouseetransforme #sejaTOTVS


Descrição da vaga


Como Analista de Implantação Protheus RH você será responsável por realizar implantação, sustentação e parametrização dos módulos de Recursos Humanos do ERP TOTVS Protheus. Sua atuação será de forma consultiva junto aos clientes internos e externos, garantindo que os processos estejam alinhados às práticas de gestão de pessoas e às exigências legais.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:


  • Executar implantação e configuração dos módulos de RH do Protheus, incluindo: Folha de Pagamento, Ponto Eletrônico, eSocial, Medicina e Segurança do Trabalho (SIGAGPE/SIGAGPE-SST), Avaliação e Pesquisa de Desempenho, APP RH, Recrutamento e Seleção;
  • Realizar levantamento de requisitos e mapeamento de processos junto às áreas de negócio;
  • Parametrizar o sistema conforme legislação vigente e políticas internas;
  • Acompanhar testes, homologações e treinamentos com usuários;
  • Propor melhorias e padronizações nos processos de gestão de pessoas via Protheus;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica e funcional das implantações;
  • Apoiar a integração entre módulos de RH e outros ambientes TOTVS.


Requisitos e qualificações

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:


  • Formação superior completa nas áreas de Tecnologia, Administração, Recursos Humanos ou correlatas;
  • Experiência na implantação ou sustentação do Protheus RH;
  • Domínio dos módulos: Folha, Ponto, eSocial, Medicina e Segurança, Avaliação, Pesquisa de Desempenho, APP RH e Recrutamento e Seleção;
  • Conhecimento em rotinas legais e obrigações acessórias (eSocial, DIRF, RAIS, CAGED, etc.);
  • Vivência em parametrizações, fórmulas, tabelas e eventos do Protheus;
  • Capacidade de analisar e propor soluções funcionais aderentes ao negócio,
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo híbrido.


Requisitos desejáveis

SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:


  • Experiência com integrações Fluig–Protheus;
  • Conhecimento em ADVPL (para acompanhamento técnico de customizações),
  • Vivência em projetos de implantação ou atualização de versão (UPDDISTR).


Benefícios


  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada pessoa colaboradora;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para nossas pessoas colaboradoras;
  • Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para pessoas colaboradoras e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...
  • Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;
  • Vale transporte e fretados em algumas estações do metrô;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Espaço de lactário;
  • Bicicletário;
  • Vestiário;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;
  • Gympass.

title: Brazil country manager (Mandarin speaker)
description:
职位描述：

1. 制定渠道销售策略，达成公司渠道销售目标。

2. 开拓新渠道，管理现有渠道，确保渠道资源的最优化利用，提高销售渠道的覆盖面和市场占有率。

3. 对渠道进行有效管理和督导，设定绩效考核标准并监控执行。

4. 分析市场并对竞争对手进行调研，预测市场动向，制定相应的销售预算和计划。

5. 协调内部的跨部门合作，确保销售活动的顺利开展并达成销售目标。

6. 建立和维护与渠道客户的合作关系，建立长期战略伙伴关系。

7. 参与制定产品推广计划，负责渠道前期市场调查、推广方案的制定、实施和效果监测等工作。


职位要求：

1. 具备本科以上学历，市场营销或相关专业背景。

2. 具有5年以上渠道销售或相关领域从业经验，有丰富的团队管理经验。

3. 具有卓越的市场分析能力、策略制定能力和决策能力。

4. 具有卓越的沟通能力和协调能力，能够建立和维护良好的客户关系。

5. 具有较强的商业敏感度和市场洞察力，善于把握市场需求和趋势。

6. 具备优秀的团队管理能力和协调能力， 能够激励和带领团队高效完成销售任务。

7. 具备良好的英语、中文听说读写能力。

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Location: San Francisco, CA - Remote (LATAM preferred)

Work Type: Full-Time


We’re partnering with a confidential, high-growth technology company in Silicon Valley that’s building AI-powered platforms. This team moves fast, cares about craftsmanship, and empowers engineers to own meaningful work for the long term.


This is a full-time, remote opportunity to join a global-first product team tackling complex problems with modern tech and a culture that values quality and speed.


✅ What You’ll Do

- Design, build, and maintain features across the stack using (insert tech stack).

- Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering peers to ship high-quality work.

- Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code.

- Contribute to architecture decisions, technical planning, and code reviews.

- Help shape team workflows, best practices, and developer experience.


What You Bring

- 7+ years of professional experience in software development as a Full Stack Developer.

- Proficiency with React, Express, MongoDB, Node.

- Strong understanding of APIs, performance, scalability, etc..

- Clear, proactive communication and comfort working on distributed, async teams.

- A product mindset and strong sense of ownership.

- Startup or high-growth team background.

- Passion for building scalable systems and great user experiences.



### **What You’ll Get**

- Competitive compensation in USD.

- 100% remote with flexible hours.

- Long-term, product-focused work with clear ownership.

- A smart, collaborative, globally distributed team.


If you’re excited to work with a fast-moving team building the future of AI at scale — let’s connect.

title: Business Analyst (TAX)
description:
Business Analyst (TAX)


***Add resume in English***


Activities:


• Serves as a Tax, Sourcing, Travel, Expense, and Real Estate applications subject matter expert associated with functionality, content, processes, and procedures.

• Assist with the design and implementation of operational and system enhancements to ensure production capabilities are both effective and efficient.

• Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders and technology staff, including off-shore personnel, to ensure that communication is open and ongoing.

• Serves as a liaison between technical and functional stakeholders and project management teams to keep initiatives moving forward smoothly and in accordance with project plans.

• Defines project scope, project strategy, deliverable priorities, and recommend alternative solutions.

• Define detailed requirements, analyze business needs, and validate solutions with the internal partners.

• Coordinate project activities, prepare agendas, document meeting outcomes, and collaborate with team members.

• Establish, administer, and maintain project and knowledge management processes and tools.

• Ensure applications are compliant with IT Policy. Build plans to enforce compliance with IT policy and standard user management processes.

• Evaluate SOC reports to ensure vendor and application compliance and surface risks.


Requirements:

• Advanced English.

• Relevant experience working with Tax, Sourcing, Shared Services, Travel, Expense, or Real Estate applications.

• Application configuration, design, and interface experience.

• Experience working with third party vendors to implement SaaS solutions.

• Working "hands-on" knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle and project management methodologies.

• Financial & Business acumen (working knowledge) and awareness of management and analysis processes, including but not limited to Tax, Procurement, Accounts Payable, Travel & Expense, and Real Estate.

• Strong PC skills, including experience using MS Office Products, especially Excel and Project.

• Excellent organization skills, and verbal and written communication skills.

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Context

We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past months, achieving 8x revenue growth in the last 18 months and a 10x usage increase over the same period. As we continue this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to ensure our products remain reliable, intuitive, and delightful for our ever-growing user base.


Mission

As a DevOps/Infrastructure team member, your primary mission will be to help ensuring that our infrastructure is scalable, reliable, and cost-effective, supporting the company’s rapid growth and evolving needs. You will play a critical role in both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic planning, helping shape our platform's future.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Infrastructure Scaling and Stability : Contribute to the continuous scaling of our infrastructure to handle increasing loads while maintaining stability and performance. This includes designing and implementing robust and scalable architectures, automating deployment processes, and optimizing resource allocation.
  • Performance Optimization : You will continuously monitor and analyze system performance, identifying bottlenecks and areas for improvement. You will also work on optimizing our infrastructure and applications to ensure low-latency, high-throughput operation, particularly for video and audio processing.
  • Cost Management : Implement strategies to optimize infrastructure costs without compromising performance. This includes rightsizing resources, automating scaling policies, and leveraging cloud provider cost-saving mechanisms.
  • Enhancing Observability : Improve our monitoring and observability capabilities, ensuring we have comprehensive visibility into the health and performance of our infrastructure. You will develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, and logs that provide actionable insights for the entire engineering team.
  • Collaboration and Support : Work closely with developers and other stakeholders to ensure seamless integration between infrastructure and applications. Provide guidance and support on infrastructure-related topics, fostering a culture of shared responsibility for the system’s reliability.
  • Security and Compliance : Contribute to the security and compliance of our infrastructure by implementing best practices and staying up-to-date with industry standards.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement : Stay abreast of industry trends and technologies and proactively suggest and implement improvements. You will have the opportunity to experiment with new tools and methodologies, driving innovation within the team.
Who We Are Looking For

We seek a highly skilled and experienced DevOps/Infrastructure Engineer who is passionate about building and maintaining scalable, reliable, and efficient infrastructure. You should have a strong background in managing complex environments across cloud providers and bare-metal servers and be comfortable working in high-performance environments, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues before they impact the system.


Key Qualifications:
  • Kubernetes  Mastery : Proven experience designing, deploying, and managing Kubernetes clusters in production environments.
  • Multi-Cloud and Bare Metal Expertise : Deep understanding of at least one primary cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and experience managing infrastructure on bare-metal servers. You should be familiar with each environment’s unique challenges and opportunities and capable of leveraging their strengths effectively.
  • Infrastructure at Scale: Demonstrated ability to architect and manage infrastructure that can scale horizontally and vertically, supporting a growing user base and increasing traffic. Experience with distributed systems, load balancing, and automated scaling strategies is essential.
  • Cost Optimization & Resource Management : Strong focus on optimizing infrastructure to balance performance and cost. You should be proficient in tools and techniques for monitoring resource usage, identifying inefficiencies, and implementing cost-saving measures.
  • Programming and Automation : Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g.Bash, Python).
  • Monitoring and Observability : You should have a deep understanding of best practices for monitoring, logging, and observability. Experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar systems is crucial. You should also be able to design systems that provide comprehensive insights into infrastructure health and performance.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset : You should thrive on solving complex problems and constantly look for ways to improve system reliability, performance, and efficiency. Strong analytical skills and a methodical approach to troubleshooting are essential.
  • Collaboration and Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. You should be comfortable collaborating across teams to ensure that infrastructure decisions support broader company goals.


Bonus Qualifications:
  • Experience with Media Processing : Familiarity with video and audio processing, streaming, or related technologies is a strong advantage. This includes understanding the performance implications and resource requirements of media workloads.
  • Familiarity with the Node.js environment and applications at scale is a strong advantage
  • Familiarity with configuration management tools like Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet is a plus

A pessoa ideal terá forte conhecimento técnico, boa comunicação em inglês e experiência com frameworks modernos de front-end e colaboração com times de UX.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver protótipos interativos usando o Polygon Studio para feedback dos usuários.
  • Criar e gerenciar repositórios de ativos compartilhados e modelos de design.
  • Construir componentes de interface reutilizáveis em Lit ou React.
  • Colaborar com as partes interessadas em requisitos e atualizações.
  • Garantir compatibilidade entre navegadores, desempenho e documentação de código limpa.
  • Desenvolver profundo conhecimento da plataforma Polygon.
  • Apoiar o onboarding de usuários e fornecer orientação técnica.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento front-end (HTML, CSS/SASS, JavaScript/TypeScript).
  • Conhecimento de frameworks modernos de web (React, Angular, Lit).
  • Experiência com bibliotecas de componentes responsivos e sistemas de design (Material UI).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão (Git).
  • Compreensão de princípios de UX e design centrado no usuário.
  • Conhecimento básico de Figma.
  • Experiência com Google Ads ou plataformas relacionadas.

title: Bolsista Graduado - Grupo Boticário - DTM.Digital – Plataforma digital| Talento Inovação -IEL/PR
description:
O Programa Talento Inovação do IEL Paraná tem como foco selecionar, acompanhar e desenvolver bolsistas, além de coordenar ações com organizações parceiras. Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I ) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa.

O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.


Projeto: DTM.Digital – Plataforma digital


Sobre a Oportunidade:


Inovação e tecnologia são forças que movem o Grupo Boticário, e você pode fazer parte dessa transformação.

Estamos em busca de um talento analítico e colaborativo para atuar no desenvolvimento fullstack de uma nova plataforma de gestão industrial, um projeto estratégico que conectará dados, inteligência artificial e eficiência operacional.

Essa solução será a base para modelos preditivos de detecção de anomalias, permitindo a otimização proativa dos processos fabris e a melhoria contínua da performance industrial.

Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e orientado à inovação, onde poderá aplicar tecnologia para gerar impacto real na indústria, essa oportunidade é para você.


Formação Acadêmica: Análise de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Engenharia de Computação ou similares


Principais Atividades:

  • Auxiliar a liderar projetos inovadores em colaboração com times de negócio, atuando desde a fase de discovery até a implementação final.
  • Desenvolver iniciativas e sistemas que impulsionem a evolução da indústria do Grupo Boticário.
  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas para sistemas industriais e produtos digitais, considerando os requisitos de infraestrutura e redes.
  • Codificar e desenvolver sistemas, integrações e aplicações web que suportam e otimizam as operações industriais.
  • Desenhar e implementar integrações robustas entre diferentes sistemas industriais.
  • Estabelecer e manter a governança de sistemas industriais, garantindo a conformidade e as boas práticas.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (operações, projetos, automação e manutenção) em discussões técnicas e funcionais.
  • Manter bom relacionamento buscando soluções inovadoras para os projetos, trabalhando de forma colaborativa e usando de boa comunicação.
  • Investigar e usar novas tecnologias quando relevante para os desafios do setor.
  • Promover e contribuir com refinamentos técnicos e funcionais junto à equipe.
  • Fornecer orientação técnica e mentoria para outros membros do time.


Conhecimentos Necessários:

  • Experiência como Back-end (preferencialmente em Node.JS).
  • Conhecimentos em Python, SQL e análise de dados.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas distribuídas e no desenvolvimento de APIs REST.
  • Vivência com ambientes em nuvem (preferencialmente AWS e GCP), incluindo o uso de serviços serverless (AWS Lambda).
  • Experiência com Kubernetes para orquestração de containers.
  • Experiência em CI/CD e versionamento de código (GitHub, com GitHub Copilot sendo um diferencial).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, como PostgreSQL e MySQL.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoria (APM e Logs), como New Relic e Grafana.
  • Conhecimento em Clean Architecture e programação orientada a objetos ou funcional.
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (Kafka ou RabbitMQ) e arquitetura orientada a eventos (pub/sub).
  • Atuação em squads ágeis de produtos digitais, com experiência em colocar soluções em produção.
  • Pensamento analítico e criativo para desenvolver soluções que atendam diferentes tipos de necessidade.
  • Grande capacidade de aprendizado de novas práticas, tecnologias e linguagens de programação.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente multifuncional, multi-linguagem e colaborativo, de maneira autônoma.
  • Pragmatismo para resolução de problemas.



Soft Skills:

  • Proatividade e iniciativa, Visão sistêmica e multidisciplinar, Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe, boa comunicação.


Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Graduado) R$3.500,00

Formato de trabalho : Remoto

Local: São José dos Pinhais – PR

title: Advogado(a) SR - Compliance e Investigações internas
description:
Qual será a sua ocupação?

Advogado(a) Sênior – Compliance e Investigações Internas.


Local de trabalho: Vaga será para atuar em um dos nossos escritórios

Regime de trabalho: A definir


O que esperamos de você?

Formação em Direito e inscrição ativa na OAB;

Experiência consolidada (mínimo 6 anos) em compliance, investigações internas, governança e riscos;

Conhecimento sólido em Lei Anticorrupção, legislação de PLD/FT e boas práticas internacionais ;

Excelente comunicação, capacidade analítica e visão estratégica;

Inglês avançado/fluente.

Bom relacionamento interpessoal;


Quais serão os seus desafios?

Estruturar, implementar e monitorar Programas de Integridade e Compliance;

Desenvolver e revisar políticas internas relacionadas a integridade, PLD/FT e controles internos;

Conduzir investigações internas e elaborar relatórios de resultados, recomendações e planos de ação;

Elaborar pareceres jurídicos sobre temas de integridade, compliance, anticorrupção e PLD/FT (Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro e ao Financiamento do Terrorismo);

Realizar due diligence de terceiros e processos de KYC, com foco em mitigação de riscos de integridade;

Apoiar clientes na obtenção de selos de integridade (ex.: Pró-Ética e Mais Integridade), desde a fase de diagnóstico até a submissão final;

Promover treinamentos e workshops em compliance, PLD/FT e cultura ética;

Interagir com reguladores e stakeholders estratégicos, oferecendo suporte técnico e estratégico.

Atuar em Processos Administrativos de Responsabilização (PAR);


Quais serão as suas recompensas?

MUITAS, queremos todos felizes e realizados!

Vale refeição;

Descontos em restaurantes parceiros;

Vale transporte;

Plano de saúde;

Plano odontológico;

Bolsa de estudos;

Wellhub (Gympass);

PPR;

Seguro de vida;

Prêmio por tempo de casa;

Folga de aniversário;

Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico com recursos modernos.


Todas as nossas oportunidades estão disponíveis para ambos os sexos e pessoas com deficiência.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados Pleno
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Sobre a Engenharia de Dados:

Somos a área responsável pela coleta, tratamento, organização e disponibilização dos dados nas soluções e API da Neoway, bem como manter a sustentação desses dados. Nossos times estão organizados de acordo com o contexto de negócio de cada pacote de dados que sustentamos. Estes times são compostos por uma coordenação técnica, responsável por fazer a ponte entre os times de dados e o time de negócio, e pessoas Engenheiras de Dados, responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e configuração de todas as etapas do fluxo da operação e produção de dados.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Dentre as principais funções do papel estão:

  • Desenvolvimento de web crawling para coleta de dados;
  • Monitoramento dos serviços de produção;
  • Evolução e manutenção de serviços de coleta, tratamento e agregação;


Requisitos e qualificações

Para desenvolver tudo isso contamos que você possua/ou esteja a fim de aprender os conhecimentos abaixo:

  • Desenvolvimento web crawling;
  • Linguagem de programação Python;
  • MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQL;
  • Parser de HTML, JSON, PDF, entre outros;


Seguimos práticas básicas de desenvolvimento:

  • Testes unitários, integração, e em alguns casos, sistema.
  • Projeto de infraestrutura como código.
  • Usamos CI do gitlab, para automatizar a maior parte de rotinas (testes, release).
  • Nos preocupamos com um código limpo e bem estruturado.
  • Fazemos Code Review. Nenhuma mudança vai para a operação sem o time aprovar. Seja via thumbs up do Gitlab ou durante uma discussão da daily.
  • Todo desenvolvimento de uma nova fonte é baseado em especificações que são escritas pela nossa pessoa Data Owner. Nela temos as definições de inputs e outputs, regras de negócio e resultados esperados. A especificação técnica fica sob responsabilidade do desenvolvedor que tem total abertura para decidir a melhor forma de desenvolvimento em conjunto com os demais colegas de time.



#NeoJourney l Cardápio de Benefícios:

Vale Alimentação/Refeição;

title: Consultor de Investimentos WS - Parceiros XP | Minas Gerais
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Informações Importantes

  • Trabalho remoto em diversas praças do país


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for "Full Stack Developer" ,Remote mode in Sao Paulo who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Mandatory skills:

  • 6+ years of experience with Java;
  • Experience with front-end (Angular);
  • Experience with AWS;
  • Advanced English


Requirements:

  • Experience in the financial industry (preferably banks);
  • Microservices;
  • Websphere;
  • OraaS;
  • MQ Series;
  • ORACLE;
  • PL/SQL;
  • KAFKA,
  • MONGODB;
  • DevOps tools as a developer





What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Technical Sourcing Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote Technical Sourcing Specialist based in Latin America with 3+ years of experience and excellent English communication skills — both written and spoken.

You’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and connecting top technical talent — including software engineers, developers, and other IT professionals — through platforms like LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing channels.

At Velozient, we’re a fast-moving, growth-stage company that values smart, proactive people who love connecting with others and enjoy the challenge of finding the best talent. You’ll play a key role in building and nurturing a high-quality pipeline that drives our hiring success.


Responsibilities

  • Proactively source, identify, and engage technical candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, social media, referrals, and other creative sourcing channels.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future technical roles.
  • Partner closely with Recruiters and Resource Managers to deeply understand technical requirements and deliver high-quality leads.
  • Conduct initial outreach and screening conversations to assess technical fit, interest level, and alignment with open positions.
  • Develop targeted search strategies using advanced Boolean logic, filters, and data mining techniques.
  • Track sourcing activity and candidate engagement using internal systems and tools.
  • Stay up to date on market trends, technologies, and sourcing innovations to improve talent pipelines continuously.
  • Represent Velozient’s brand professionally and enthusiastically in all candidate interactions.
  • Support diversity sourcing initiatives and help drive inclusive hiring practices.


REQUIRED Experience:

  • Excellent English skills — both written and verbal.
  • Minimum of 3+ years of experience in candidate sourcing or talent acquisition, with a focus on technical roles (e.g., software engineering, IT, data, or product).
  • Proven experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools.
  • Strong understanding of Boolean search, technical keyword targeting, and sourcing best practices.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.


Preferred Experience:

  • University degree.
  • Prior experience sourcing for North American-based companies.
  • Experience in a growth-stage or entrepreneurial organization.


What YOU Get!

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let’s learn from them -be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), designated national holidays, three sick leave days, and one floating day annually

Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
